title: The packing spectrum: interpolation between Hausdorff and packing dimensions
summary: We introduce a family of metric outer measures whose critical exponents form a packing spectrum interpolating between Hausdorff and packing dimensions. For analytic sets, we characterize each spectral value as the supremum of the Hausdorff dimension of a product with a compact testing set minus the testing set's upper intermediate dimension at the complementary parameter. The associated product bounds refine the classical Hausdorff--packing inequalities and can give exact Hausdorff additivity when both factors have distinct endpoint dimensions.
